verdict.rationale: Docs give a concrete quickstart example ("Go to google flights and find the cheapest flight...") plus dedicated use-case docs for form-filling, multi-step session workflows, navigation, and data extraction, and community feedback confirms real-world use ("wrote a complex prompt and it did a good job", "impressive demo"). Missing for 10: independent reproducible benchmarks/evals (community explicitly asks for this and it's unanswered) and no hands-on failure reports to corroborate reliability at scale.
